items.title: Aydem Yenilenebilir Enerji A.Ş. announced today its offer to purchase for cash its 7.75% Senior Secured Green Notes due 2027
items.summary: Aydem Yenilenebilir Enerji A.Ş. (the "Offeror") announced today its offer to purchase for cash the securities listed below (the "Offer"). The Offer is subject to the terms and conditions described in the tender offer memorandum dated September 18, 2025 (the "Tender Offer Memorandum"). The Tender Offer Memorandum can be obtained at the following website: https://debtxportal.issuerservices.citigroup
